courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 台灣高速鐵路
related.transfer: 可遷移「施工窗口與可完成工作量」與「速度限制轉換與預告距離」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；台灣高速鐵路的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Possession window and achievable work" and "Speed-limit transition and warning distance" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Taiwan High Speed Rail must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦新建都市鐵路隧道接網與全線整合；台灣高速鐵路則以高速鐵路車軌橋與地震系統介面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on new urban rail tunnel network integration and service transition; Taiwan High Speed Rail centres on high speed vehicle track bridge and seismic interfaces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「施工窗口與可完成工作量」與「延遲與制動距離」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到台灣高速鐵路，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「再生煞車能量與受電條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Possession window and achievable work” and “Delay and braking distance”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Taiwan High Speed Rail, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Regenerative energy and receptivity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 山陽新幹線

related.difference: 本課聚焦新建都市鐵路隧道接網與全線整合；山陽新幹線則以山岳高速線隧道壓力與橋隧連續性為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on new urban rail tunnel network integration and service transition; Sanyo Shinkansen centres on mountain high speed tunnel pressure and bridge continuity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「施工窗口與可完成工作量」與「隧道壓力波傳遞」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到山陽新幹線，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「沉陷差與軌道坡折」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Possession window and achievable work” and “Tunnel pressure-wave travel”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sanyo Shinkansen, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Differential settlement and track kink", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 墨爾本地鐵隧道計畫
history.text: 公開工程與出版時間線：2015 年：墨爾本地鐵隧道展開早期現地調查工作；2025 年：墨爾本地鐵隧道於十一月開放旅客服務；2026 年：二月班表轉換將地鐵隧道整合進完整營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以墨爾本地鐵隧道從建設到接入營運網路的背景，建立新站、隧道及既有郊區鐵路協同運轉的教學案例。學徒把施工沉陷、試驗紀錄、進路切換及轉乘時間相連，分開首次載客與完整班表整合兩個系統狀態。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。
history.textEn: Public engineering and publication chronology: 2015: Early site investigations for Melbourne Metro Tunnel began; 2025: Melbourne Metro Tunnel opened to passengers in November; 2026: The February timetable change integrated Metro Tunnel into full operations. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Melbourne Metro Tunnel’s transition from construction to network operation to construct a teaching case joining new stations and tunnels to suburban railways. Link construction movement, test records, route switching and transfer time. Treat the first passenger opening and full timetable integration as distinct system states with different acceptance and operating evidence. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「施工窗口與可完成工作量」到「可用度與修復時間」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Possession window and achievable work" through "Availability and repair time" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
